item.title: [IGNITE-7751] Pages Write Throttle mode doesn't protect from checkpoint buffer overflow
item.description:

The problem is that we apply throttling by checkpoint buffer only for pages that are present in current checkpoint:

if (isPageInCheckpoint) {
    int checkpointBufLimit = pageMemory.checkpointBufferPagesSize() * 2 / 3;

    shouldThrottle = pageMemory.checkpointBufferPagesCount() > checkpointBufLimit;
}

On the other hand, we clear backoff counter if we don't apply throttling, which can happen for page which is not in checkpoint:

if (shouldThrottle) {
    int throttleLevel = exponentialBackoffCntr.getAndIncrement();

    LockSupport.parkNanos((long)(STARTING_THROTTLE_NANOS * Math.pow(BACKOFF_RATIO, throttleLevel)));
}
else
    exponentialBackoffCntr.set(0);

Possible solution: introduce two separate backoff counters for pages in / not in checkpoint.
